name: OCNCASH
recent: OCNCASH 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日完成收购 Paragon Car Carpets & Components Sdn Bhd 全部股权，代价 RM13.42 million 全数以现金支付，后者成为其全资子公司。2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间，多名董事及大股东在闭市期内外进行股份转让与增持，包括执行主席 Tan Siew Chin 转移 700 万股予两名董事。公司也于 8 月 27 日公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度业绩，并披露经常性关联交易金额超过 RM1 million 门槛。
notable: 完成以 RM13.42 million 现金收购 Paragon Car Carpets & Components Sdn Bhd 全部股权，后者成为全资子公司。
执行主席 Tan Siew Chin 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日转移 700 万股予董事 Tan Wey Chien 及 Tan Wey Chung。
执行董事兼集团首席执行官 Tan Wey Chien 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日以闭市期交易方式增持 500 万股。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭市期内进行股份交易，包括执行主席转移股份及首席执行官增持。
公司披露的经常性关联交易于 2025 年 8 月 1 日至 2026 年 7 月 31 日期间累计金额超过 RM1 million 门槛。

recent_en: OCNCASH completed the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Paragon Car Carpets & Components Sdn Bhd for RM13.42 million cash on 3 September 2026, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. Between October and November 2026, several directors and a substantial shareholder conducted share transfers and acquisitions, including Executive Chairman Tan Siew Chin transferring 7 million shares to two directors. The company also announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August and disclosed recurrent related party transactions exceeding the RM1 million threshold.
notable_en: Completed the acquisition of the entire equity interest in Paragon Car Carpets & Components Sdn Bhd for RM13.42 million cash, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary.
Executive Chairman Tan Siew Chin transferred 7 million shares to Directors Tan Wey Chien and Tan Wey Chung on 27 October 2026.
Executive Director and Group CEO Tan Wey Chien acquired 5 million shares on 6 November 2026 during the closed period.
risks_en: Directors and a substantial shareholder conducted share dealings during the closed period, including a transfer by the Executive Chairman and an acquisition by the CEO.
The company disclosed that aggregate recurrent related party transactions exceeded the RM1 million threshold for the period from 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2026.
